# MAJOR RELEASE

Initial release of `@obinesto/react-carousel`. Requires React 18 or later.

- Configure fixed or content-sized slides, gaps, alignment, and navigation by slide or visible group.
- Set responsive layouts based on the carousel container width.
- Use finite navigation or wrap between the first and last slides with `loop`.
- Enable autoplay with playback controls, hover suspension, focus-stop behavior, and reduced-motion handling.
- Customize navigation, pagination, accessible labels, and styles, or use external controls.
- Read selection, visible slides, and playback state through the public API and events.

Autoplay is off by default. Looping wraps navigation at the ends; native scrolling stops at physical edges.

Install with `npm install @obinesto/react-carousel` and import `@obinesto/react-carousel/carousel/carousel.css` for the default styles.
